questions.question: Four words have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
questions.solution:
The logic is:

*1) *Stag → A male deer is called stag.

*2) *Larva → A larva is the young stage of some insects.

*3) *Nymph → A nymph is the young stage of some kinds of invertebrates, especially insects.

*4) *Foal → The young one of a horse is called a foal.

So, all options except ‘stag’ refers to young ones of animals or insects.

Hence, **Stag** is the odd one out.

questions.question: Four words have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the word that is different.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**All options are the groups whereas piglet is a single young pig.**

By checking options:

**1) Piglet → a young pig.**

2) Horde → a large group of people.

3) Herd → a large group of animals, especially hoofed mammals, that live together or are kept together as livestock.

4) Ambush → A group of tigers

Hence, piglet is the odd one.

questions.question: Four options have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the option that is different.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Option (1) Sri Lanka → **Sri Lanka***** ***is an** island **country**.**

**Option (2) Bangladesh**** →** **Bangladesh is not an island country.**

Option (3) Singapore → **Singapore **is an** island **country**.**

Option (4) Indonesia → **Indonesia **is an** island **country**.**

**Note:-** **An island country is a nation that is made up of one or more islands or land that is surrounded completely by water.**

Hence, **“****Bangladesh****”** is an odd one.

questions.question: Four words have been given out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
questions.solution:
The meaning of the given words are:

**Oyster: A shellfish**

Shark: A large sea fish with sharp teeth.

Salmon: A large fish with silver skin

Cod: A large sea fish that lives in the North Atlantic

All the above words are examples of sea fish except Oyster which is a shell fish.
